entities.summary: Reginald Dwayne Slater is an American former professional basketball player born in Houston, Texas. He played the power forward position and played college basketball for the Wyoming Cowboys. His son Rashawn Slater was a first round draft choice by the Los Angeles Chargers. Reggie married Katie Slater. Reggie has four kids, Aliyah Slater, Reginald Slater Jr. (RJ), Rashawn Slater, and Rylan Slater. RJ played football for the Air Force Academy in 2014–2018.
